name: Saad Ahmed
title: Growth & Performance Marketing Leader
tagline: Full-funnel digital growth that maximizes revenue, reduces CAC, and increases client LTV.
about: Saad Ahmed is a growth and performance marketing leader based in Karachi, Pakistan. He has scaled agency revenue, built high-performing digital teams, led multi-market campaigns, and helped brands across telecom, technology, food, finance, automotive, healthcare, and FMCG grow with sharper strategy, stronger retention, and measurable commercial impact.

experience.description: Delivered 300% total revenue growth over three years, developed a $2.5M+ upsell and cross-sell engine, expanded the agency from digital into tech and mobility, improved client retention to 2.5+ years, and launched Pakistan's first AI chatbot for K-Electric.

Increased monthly revenue by 60% in consecutive fiscal years, grew media into a top revenue unit, secured qualified leads at GITEX Dubai, and led campaigns recognized by Dragons of Pakistan & Asia, Pakistan Digital Awards, and Effie.

Led digital marketing for a global blockchain healthcare platform, launched and revamped digital assets across regions, drove 8M+ impressions for a partner reveal, and helped increase digital currency value by 600% within 15 days.
Led 360-degree product launch marketing across digital, social, e-commerce, PR, events, and media, raising brand image by 42%, brand trend by 37%, and top-of-mind awareness by 130% in 60 days.

Expanded account revenue by 300% in mobile and 200% in food and restaurants, delivered 500%+ fashion category sales growth, and led integrated campaigns across media, influencers, PR, SEM, and content.
